indicators.title: Residents
indicators.note: Permanent resident population on 31 December. Register-based from 2010, estimates before.

indicators.title: Arrivals minus departures
indicators.note: International and intercantonal migration. Includes people who move from the non-permanent to the permanent resident population, for example after a year in Switzerland.

indicators.title: Median age
indicators.note: Half of the residents are older than this, half younger. Computed from the population by single year of age.

indicators.title: Aged 90 or older
indicators.note: Before 2010 the figures are estimates, which counted too many very old people.

indicators.title: Marriages
indicators.note: From 2022 including marriages between people of the same sex.

indicators.title: Divorces
indicators.note: The drop in 2000 follows the new divorce law. The way divorces are counted changed in 2011.

indicators.title: Passenger cars
indicators.note: Cars registered on 30 September. From 2018 counted by number plate, before by the holder's address.

indicators.title: Passenger cars per 1,000 residents
indicators.note: Cars on 30 September divided by the residents at the start of the year, as in the official rate. Before 2011 the population was an estimate and slightly too high, so the rate was a little low.

indicators.title: Electric cars
indicators.note: Battery-electric cars as a share of all registered cars. Hybrids are not included.

indicators.title: Registered unemployment rate
indicators.source: State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO), published by the Federal Statistical Office
indicators.note: People registered at a regional employment office and without a job, yearly average of the monthly rates. Until 1982 only the fully unemployed. It leaves out the jobless who are not registered, and cross-border workers who lose their job register in their own country.

indicators.title: Unemployment rate by the international definition
indicators.note: From the labour force survey, ILO definition: residents without work who looked for a job in the last four weeks and could start, whether registered or not. A sample survey: the figure for Ticino has a margin of error, so small moves from one year to the next mean little.

indicators.title: Jobs in Ticino
indicators.note: Jobs in businesses located in the canton, in December, whoever holds them and wherever they live; a person with two jobs counts twice. From the business register, available from 2011.

indicators.title: Jobs in services
indicators.note: Jobs in businesses located in the canton, in December, whoever holds them and wherever they live; a person with two jobs counts twice. From the business register, available from 2011. Services are trade, transport, hotels, finance, public administration, health, schools and the other activities of the tertiary sector.

indicators.title: Cross-border workers per 100 jobs
indicators.note: Cross-border workers in the third quarter divided by the jobs counted in December of the same year. The two counts come from different sources, so it is an order of magnitude.

indicators.title: Residents working in industry and construction
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only. Employed residents by the sector of their job, without those who gave no sector; cross-border workers are not counted.

indicators.title: Residents working in services
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only. Employed residents by the sector of their job, without those who gave no sector; cross-border workers are not counted.

indicators.title: Residents working in farming and forestry
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only. Employed residents by the sector of their job, without those who gave no sector; cross-border workers are not counted.

indicators.title: Median monthly wage
indicators.note: Gross monthly median wage for a full-time job, wage structure survey, every two years. 2002-2010 covers the private sector and the Confederation; from 2012 the whole economy.

indicators.title: Median wage compared with Switzerland
indicators.note: Gross monthly median wage for a full-time job, wage structure survey, every two years. 2002-2010 covers the private sector and the Confederation; from 2012 the whole economy.

indicators.title: Cross-border workers
indicators.note: Foreign cross-border commuters working in Ticino, third quarter of each year. The latest figures are provisional.

indicators.title: Health insurance premium
indicators.source: Federal Office of Public Health; Federal Statistical Office
indicators.note: Mean premium per insured person for compulsory health insurance, all ages and models, before subsidies. Until 2022 from the FOPH statistics (1996, 2000, 2005, 2010, then yearly from 2015); 2023 and 2024 from the Federal Statistical Office, twelve times the mean monthly premium.

indicators.title: Health premium compared with the median wage
indicators.source: Federal Office of Public Health; Federal Statistical Office
indicators.note: One person's yearly premium divided by twelve gross median monthly wages. The 2010 wage covers the private sector and the Confederation, later years the whole economy.

indicators.title: Average monthly rent
indicators.note: Average monthly net rent, without charges, of rented dwellings of any size. Available for 2000, 2003 and from 2010. The survey changed in 2015 and 2018: the drop in 2015 is due to the new questionnaire.

indicators.title: Average rent compared with the median wage
indicators.note: Average rent divided by the gross median monthly wage. The 2010 wage covers the private sector and the Confederation, later years the whole economy.

indicators.title: Vacant homes
indicators.note: Dwellings vacant and on offer on 1 June.

indicators.title: Farms
indicators.note: Farm census: every five years until 1990, yearly from 1996.

indicators.title: People working on farms
indicators.note: Farm census: every five years until 1990, yearly from 1996.

indicators.title: Cattle
indicators.note: Farm census: every five years until 1990, yearly from 1996.

indicators.title: Goats
indicators.note: Farm census: every five years until 1990, yearly from 1996.

indicators.title: Road accidents with injuries
indicators.note: Accidents in which someone was injured or killed. Counts accidents, not people.

indicators.title: Road accidents with deaths
indicators.note: Counts accidents, not people killed.

indicators.title: Hotel overnight stays
indicators.note: Hotels and health establishments only. Campsites and holiday flats are not included.

indicators.title: Households of one person
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only.

indicators.title: Italian as main language
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only.

indicators.title: German as main language
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only.

indicators.title: Roman Catholics
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only. People who gave no answer rose from 1.1% in 1990 to 4.7% in 2000.

indicators.title: No religious affiliation
indicators.note: From the federal census: 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 only.

indicators.title: Turnout in National Council elections
indicators.note: Every four years.

indicators.title: FDP (PLR)
indicators.note: Share of the vote in National Council elections in Ticino, every four years.

indicators.title: The Centre (formerly PPD)
indicators.note: Share of the vote in National Council elections in Ticino, every four years.

indicators.title: Social Democrats (PS)
indicators.note: Share of the vote in National Council elections in Ticino, every four years. Until 1991 without the Partito socialista autonomo, a separate party that had 7 to 11% of the vote and merged with the PS in 1992.

indicators.title: Lega dei Ticinesi
indicators.note: Share of the vote in National Council elections in Ticino, every four years.

indicators.title: Swiss People's Party (UDC)
indicators.note: Share of the vote in National Council elections in Ticino, every four years.

indicators.title: Greens
indicators.note: Share of the vote in National Council elections in Ticino, every four years. In 2019 and 2023 on joint lists with smaller left-wing parties.

indicators.title: Turnout in federal votes
indicators.note: Average turnout over all federal ballot questions of the year.

indicators.title: Federal votes where Ticino sided with the Swiss majority
indicators.note: By decade. Compares the popular majority in Ticino with the national popular majority. Tie-break questions are left out.

indicators.title: Average temperature in Lugano
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.

indicators.title: Days at 25 °C or more
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.

indicators.title: Days at 30 °C or more
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.

indicators.title: Nights at 20 °C or more
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.

indicators.title: Days with frost
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.

indicators.title: Precipitation
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.

indicators.title: Sunshine
indicators.note: Lugano station, homogenised yearly series. The figures compared are 10-year averages.
